# freeze-request

> Evidence packages for a stablecoin issuer's freeze team or a law-enforcement referral: transaction chain, off-ramp points, token contracts and addresses, a stated tracing rule, balances and a timeline, as JSON and Markdown, with GENIUS Act lawful-order checks and the issuers' published freeze policies. Engineering checklist, not legal advice.

A freeze needs a lawful order or the issuer's own decision under its policy; the package is neither, and says so. Standard library only; never queries a blockchain. Tested on synthetic data only.

Built and maintained by Art Akopian, CEO of Banrox (https://banrox.com).

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/freeze-request/blob/main/README.md): Checks, tracing rule, case format, what is real and what is not.
- [docs/sources.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/freeze-request/blob/main/docs/sources.md): Primary sources.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/freeze-request/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent skill for preparing a freeze request.

## Source

- [checks.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/freeze-request/blob/main/src/freezereq/checks.py): The FR rules.
- [trace.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/freeze-request/blob/main/src/freezereq/trace.py): Stolen-first tracing.
- [issuers.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/freeze-request/blob/main/src/freezereq/issuers.py): Issuer policies with sources.
- [build.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/freeze-request/blob/main/src/freezereq/build.py): JSON and Markdown output.
